target_customer: Enterprises with document-heavy intake and back-office workflows (earlier product: SaaS companies wanting embedded analytics)
problem: Enterprise operations teams spend days on document intake and ERP or CRM updates; the company sells AI agents that do it in minutes.
business_model: Custom agent deployment and services with onsite engineers, per the company site; earlier embedded AI data scientist product
product_category: AI agents for enterprise document workflows

founders.name: Hansen Qian
founders.background_notes: Only founder listed on the YC page; company site names no team.

competitors.name: Tableau
competitors.what: Established BI and dashboard tool that the early Lightski product positioned against

competitors.name: Looker
competitors.what: BI platform named on the YC page as the comparison for the embedded AI data scientist

technical_complexity.rationale: Early product combined LLM code execution with data connectors in a one-person team; later agent work needs enterprise integrations and computer-use agents.

defensibility.rationale: Model access is shared with everyone; the only stickiness is custom enterprise integrations.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: OpenAI shipped a code interpreter in 2023 and BI vendors added AI features; the company later moved away from embedded analytics to agents.

market_need_then: Large language models became usable in early 2023, creating demand for AI inside analytics and for automating document-heavy back-office work; the company claims one customer cut intake from 2 days to 10 minutes (unverified).

identity.voice_and_tone: Direct enterprise claims about speed and cost savings

branding.community_and_virality: Covered once by MarkTechPost in 2024 as a way to embed ChatGPT code interpreter in an app; no other brand coverage found.

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community about the brand itself was found, and searches for it returned unrelated brands.

pivots.from: Embedded AI data scientist for SaaS apps
pivots.to: AI agents for document-heavy enterprise workflows
pivots.why: Not stated by the company; the current site and YC page show the shift.

outcome_analysis: Lightski remains active with a one-person listing on YC and no public sign of a later round or exit. It moved from an embedded analytics product to enterprise agent services, a common response to commoditised LLM data tools. Traction claims are company-reported only, so its trajectory is unclear.
notes: CB Insights and VCBacked show about $500K from Y Combinator (convertible note or pre-seed, dated 2023-01 or 2023-04, sources disagree); aggregator only, so not recorded as a round. No later rounds found. Outcome search returned nothing about this company. Dated competitor sources are thin; Tableau and Looker are named on the YC page without a date. Search tool returned a MarkTechPost date of mid 2024 for the product launch. Round rests on two databases (CB Insights: convertible note dated 2023-01; VCBacked: pre-seed dated 2023-04, https://www.vcbacked.co/company/lightski), so the date is recorded as 2023. No press confirmation.
